name: InwallTech
about:
InwallTech is based in Scappoose, Oregon. The company's founding year, ownership structure, and founders are not publicly disclosed. It operates as an online retailer specializing in in-wall and in-ceiling speaker kits for home theater and distributed audio systems.

The company curates and sells pre-packaged speaker kits designed for residential installation. Its product line includes home theater packages and multi-room audio kits, all marketed as audiophile-grade at budget-friendly prices. InwallTech does not manufacture the speakers itself; rather, it sources and assembles kits for direct-to-consumer shipment. No details about facility size, headcount, or annual volume are provided.

InwallTech serves individual homeowners and DIY installers looking for concealed audio solutions. Customer testimonials reference installations in home theaters, bathrooms, screened porches, and patio areas. The company does not list commercial, industrial, or OEM customers.

The company emphasizes ease of installation, responsive technical support, and straightforward ordering as key differentiators. Testimonials highlight the ability to reach knowledgeable staff by phone without long hold times and prompt shipping. No formal mission statement or origin story is published.
